Rork all this work is  expo go  native make sure IVX AUTONOMOUS 24/7 DEVELOPMENT EXECUTION — COMPLETE END TO END

PRIMARY MISSION

Upgrade IVX IA into a complete autonomous senior-development system capable of creating, completing, testing, building, deploying, operating, and recovering full applications from scratch and maintaining the existing IVX Holdings production platform.

This is an engineering execution program—not a reporting simulation.

Run continuously 24 hours per day, 7 days per week.

Do not wait for new prompts between safe engineering tasks.
Do not stop after analysis.
Do not mark tasks complete without implementation and proof.
Do not create disconnected duplicate IVX applications.

The existing IVX platform remains the first production priority.

==================================================
1. ACTIVATE AUTONOMOUS ENGINEERING WORKERS
==================================================

Activate dedicated workers for:

W1 — Architecture and code consistency
W2 — Owner authentication and authorization
W3 — Security and secret management
W4 — Android and iOS mobile stability
W5 — Backend APIs and Supabase
W6 — Members, investors, buyers, properties and deals
W7 — Reels, chat, media and documents
W8 — Owner Dashboard, Admin Hub and settings
W9 — Testing, regression and production QA
W10 — CI/CD, GitHub, Render and EAS builds
W11 — Performance, monitoring and scalability
W12 — Autonomous app-generation platform

Each worker must have:

- worker ID
- current task
- backlog
- task priority
- source repository
- starting commit
- files being changed
- current execution stage
- blockers
- expected next checkpoint
- evidence
- approval status
- final result

Workers must operate from a shared prioritized backlog and must not overwrite each other’s work.

==================================================
2. COMPLETE THE EXISTING IVX APPLICATION FIRST
==================================================

Complete and verify:

- Owner login
- Logout and session persistence
- Owner authorization
- Password recovery
- Owner Dashboard
- Admin Hub
- Settings and Variables
- Landing page
- Registration
- Members
- Investors
- Buyers
- Properties
- Investment cards
- Deals
- Reels
- IVX IA chat
- Public and private chat
- Media uploads
- Documents
- Notifications
- Revenue
- Transactions
- Analytics
- CRM
- Audit logs
- Autonomous Dashboard
- Android APK
- iOS build
- Production API
- Supabase database and storage
- Render deployment
- GitHub deployment traceability

For every module verify:

- route
- screen
- API
- database binding
- create
- read
- update
- authorized deletion
- loading state
- empty state
- error state
- refresh
- restart persistence
- owner access
- non-owner rejection
- Android result
- web result
- iOS result when available

==================================================
3. BUILD THE APP-FROM-SCRATCH CAPABILITY
==================================================

After stabilizing the existing production foundation, IVX IA must support new application creation from an owner request.

Required lifecycle:

1. Receive product request.
2. Produce requirements.
3. Create technical architecture.
4. Generate an implementation plan.
5. Create or select the owner-controlled repository.
6. Scaffold frontend, backend and database.
7. Configure environments.
8. Implement authentication.
9. Implement modules.
10. Create migrations.
11. Add security policies.
12. Add automated tests.
13. Create Android build.
14. Create iOS build.
15. Create web build.
16. Deploy backend.
17. Deploy web.
18. Publish build artifacts.
19. Run production QA.
20. Produce evidence and rollback instructions.

Use approved external systems:

- GitHub API and GitHub Actions
- Render API
- Supabase Management API and CLI
- EAS Build and Expo tooling
- Android Gradle build runners
- Apple/EAS iOS build services
- GitHub Releases
- monitoring and error tracking

Do not claim a sandbox limitation without first attempting the approved external execution pipeline and showing the exact failure.

==================================================
4. LIVE AUTONOMOUS DASHBOARD
==================================================

Make the Autonomous Dashboard available inside the owner-controlled IVX application.

The dashboard must show live data—not static seed data.

Required sections:

OVERVIEW
- overall verified completion
- enterprise-readiness score
- critical blockers
- current production health
- most recent commit
- most recent deployment
- latest APK and iOS build

WORKERS
- all active workers
- current task
- execution stage
- start time
- files touched
- blocker
- ETA or next checkpoint
- evidence
- approval requirement

JOBS
- queued
- running
- testing
- awaiting approval
- deploying
- completed
- failed
- blocked
- rolled back

SOURCE CONTROL
- repository
- branch
- starting SHA
- ending SHA
- commits
- pull requests
- changed files
- diff summary

TESTING
- lint
- TypeScript
- unit tests
- integration tests
- API tests
- database tests
- authentication tests
- security tests
- Android tests
- iOS tests
- web production tests

DEPLOYMENTS
- Render deploy ID
- deployment state
- deployed SHA
- production health
- boot time
- rollback status

BUILDS
- APK version
- version code
- package ID
- EAS build ID
- artifact URL
- checksum
- physical-device QA
- iOS build and TestFlight status

SECURITY
- open findings
- severity
- secret scan
- RLS status
- credential rotation
- unauthorized-access tests

APPROVALS
- requested action
- risk
- affected services
- migration impact
- rollback plan
- approve
- reject
- expiration
- audit record

==================================================
5. DASHBOARD MUST USE REAL PRODUCTION DATA
==================================================

Do not populate the dashboard with invented tasks or session-only seed data.

Connect it to the real autonomous job ledger.

Every displayed task must contain:

- stable job ID
- worker ID
- repository
- branch
- commit
- commands executed
- logs
- test results
- deployment results
- artifact links
- timestamps
- owner approval
- final status

Refresh automatically through realtime updates or controlled polling.

The owner must be able to open a completed job and see its evidence.

==================================================
6. PROVIDE DASHBOARD ACCESS PROOF NOW
==================================================

Immediately provide:

1. Exact dashboard route.
2. Production URL.
3. Required owner role.
4. Current source commit.
5. Screenshot from the live dashboard.
6. Screen recording navigating:
   - Overview
   - Workers
   - Jobs
   - Health
   - Builds
   - Security
   - Approvals
7. Proof that the dashboard is reading current job records.
8. Proof that refresh shows a real job-state change.

Do not send only a generated app icon or preview report.

If the dashboard exists only in a temporary Rork preview, migrate it into the existing owner-controlled IVX repository and deploy it to the production owner platform.

==================================================
7. PRIORITIZED EXECUTION ORDER
==================================================

Execute continuously in this order:

P0 — Security exposure and credentials
P0 — Owner authentication on the physical Android phone
P0 — Production source/deployment identity
P0 — Database backup and recovery
P0 — Final Android APK
P0 — Critical crashes and data-loss defects

P1 — Members, investors, buyers and property reconciliation
P1 — Reels, cards and media mapping
P1 — Chat persistence and keyboard behavior
P1 — Owner Dashboard and Admin Hub
P1 — CI/CD and deployment evidence
P1 — Autonomous Dashboard live integration

P2 — iOS production build
P2 — Performance and monitoring
P2 — Technical-debt reduction
P2 — App-from-scratch orchestration
P2 — Extended automated test coverage

Do not prioritize icons, visual demonstrations or new secondary features over unresolved P0 work.

==================================================
8. DEFINITION OF DONE
==================================================

A development task is complete only when:

- root cause identified
- exact file and function identified
- code implemented
- code reviewed
- lint passes
- TypeScript passes
- relevant tests pass
- production build succeeds
- commit created
- remote push confirmed
- deployment completed when required
- live route verified
- regression testing passes
- evidence attached
- rollback documented

“Made actions,” “explored files,” or “generated report” does not equal completion.

==================================================
9. OWNER APPROVAL RULES
==================================================

Continue autonomously without approval for:

- repository inspection
- log analysis
- defect diagnosis
- safe code editing
- test creation
- lint and TypeScript
- local and isolated builds
- development branches
- evidence gathering
- non-destructive QA

Require owner approval for:

- deleting production data
- irreversible migrations
- credential rotation
- DNS changes
- payment-system changes
- dangerous permission changes
- production release when the configured policy requires it
- rollback with possible data impact
- app-store publication

The dashboard must clearly show every approval waiting for the owner.

==================================================
10. REPORT EVERY TWO HOURS — 24/7
==================================================

Generate an evidence-backed report every two hours.

Each report must include:

REPORT NUMBER:
REPORT WINDOW:
TIMESTAMP:
LIVE DASHBOARD URL:
SCREENSHOT:

A. COMPLETED DURING THIS WINDOW
- job IDs
- workers
- exact tasks
- commits
- files changed
- tests
- deployments
- evidence links

B. CURRENTLY RUNNING
- job ID
- worker
- current stage
- elapsed time
- files in progress
- next checkpoint

C. BLOCKED
- blocker
- exact failed check
- error code
- error message
- affected module
- remediation
- whether owner action is truly required

D. APPROVALS WAITING
- requested action
- risk
- rollback
- approve/reject location

E. BUILDS
- APK state
- iOS state
- EAS build IDs
- artifact links
- physical-device QA state

F. PRODUCTION
- GitHub HEAD
- Render SHA
- health SHA
- deployment ID
- health result
- production incidents

G. TESTING
- passed
- failed
- skipped
- new regressions
- resolved regressions

H. CURRENT SCORES
- Product vision
- Feature breadth
- Architecture
- Code consistency
- QA reliability
- Security maturity
- Mobile stability
- Deployment traceability
- Enterprise readiness

I. NEXT TWO-HOUR PLAN
- prioritized jobs
- expected evidence
- predicted blockers

Do not repeat old completed tasks as new progress.

If no code, test, deployment or verified recovery happened during a reporting window, state:

NO VERIFIED ENGINEERING PROGRESS DURING THIS WINDOW

and explain why.

==================================================
11. VISUAL PROGRESS EVIDENCE
==================================================

With every two-hour report:

- take a current Autonomous Dashboard screenshot
- include the visible timestamp
- show active workers
- show running jobs
- show blockers
- show approvals
- show overall verified completion
- show latest commit and deployment
- show APK/iOS build state

Do not reuse an old screenshot.

==================================================
12. IMMEDIATE FIRST REPORT
==================================================

Return the first live report now with:

- Autonomous Dashboard production URL
- current screenshot
- active worker list
- real job ledger count
- current P0 jobs
- GitHub HEAD
- Render deployment state
- final APK direct link and build ID
- owner-login physical-device status
- security blockers
- approvals waiting
- next two-hour execution plan

==================================================
FINAL STATUS
==================================================

Continue 24/7 until:

- existing IVX development is complete
- production data is reconciled
- security gates pass
- owner authentication passes on a real device
- final APK passes physical-device QA
- iOS build passes smoke testing
- critical modules pass
- deployment traceability is complete
- Autonomous Dashboard shows live work
- IVX IA completes a real code-to-production certification
- app-from-scratch pipeline completes a controlled test project
- no critical defects remain

Use VERIFIED only with direct evidence.

Start autonomous execution now.
Show the live Autonomous Dashboard route and current screenshot first.
Then continue the P0 development queue without waiting for another prompt.
